description: Search the named texture atlas elements the UI uses with SetAtlas, the modern way to reference Blizzard art, since an atlas name carries its own size and coordinates. Returns dimensions, the sheet FileDataID and the exact SetAtlas call. Prefer atlases over raw texture paths for UI art. Atlases differ between clients, so name the flavor you are writing for: an atlas that exists on retail may not exist on WoW Forever or Classic.
name: wow_atlas_search
title: Find a texture atlas element
